content: For Single - frame transmission, if PduR_<DstLoTp>CopyTxData is called with TpDataState TP_DATARETRY, the PDU Router shall set back the current position by TxTpDataCnt bytes and copy SduLength bytes of data. If the Pdu Router cannot set back the position as requested, it shall return BUF REQ_E_NOT_OK without changing the current position or copying any data. If, after resetting the current position, not enough data is available for copying, the Pdu Router shall return BUFREQ_E_BUSY without copying any data .
